long_biography.plain_text:
Poniatowski built his career in investment banking at Lazard, working in the United States, France and Spain and becoming a managing director in mergers, acquisitions and corporate advisory. In 1996, he became a founding shareholder of Royalty Pharma and joined its investment governance, linking his banking experience to life-sciences investing. He later chaired HBM Partners and served on boards across private equity and investment businesses.

Today he works through Alpha Star, which he co-founded with Alexandre Cadain to make long-term investments in technology, culture and finance and support portfolio companies at board level. This record supports finance and investing as both the source and current focus of his wealth. The title Prince identifies his family lineage but does not establish any inherited operating company, trust entitlement or personal asset. Royalty Pharma's corporate value, Quilvest's assets under management, Alpha Star's portfolio values and Fondation ARPE's charitable property remain separate from his personal holdings.
